compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)

pin_diff.note: PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 1: LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB assigns ADJ (ADJ) whereas NCP1117LPST33T3G assigns Adj (GND) (GND) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
Functionally identical VOUT pin (VOUT vs Vout).
Functionally identical VIN pin (VIN vs Vin).

parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.
Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (ADJ vs GND). Soldering NCP1117LPST33T3G onto a LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
CRITICAL OUTPUT CONFIGURATION MISMATCH: LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB is adjustable (Vref=1.25 V) (p.7) whereas NCP1117LPST33T3G is fixed 3.3 V (p.3); PCB resistor-divider footprint change is required.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: NCP1117LPST33T3G is rated to only 12 V rec. (18 V abs max, p.2) vs LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB at 15 V rec. (20 V abs max, p.4). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB supplies up to 800 mA (p.7) compared to NCP1117LPST33T3G at 1000 mA (p.1); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 75% higher on NCP1117LPST33T3G (LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB: 61.6 °C/W p.4 vs NCP1117LPST33T3G: 108 °C/W p.2); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: NCP1117LPST33T3G requires Vin,min >= 4.8 V (p.3) vs 2.65 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB: -40..125 °C Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ, LM1117I grade) vs NCP1117LPST33T3G: 0..125 °C Commercial (0°C to +125°C TA/TJ)); NCP1117LPST33T3G cold limit only 0 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB (Texas Instruments, SOT-223-3) and NCP1117LPST33T3G (onsemi, SOT-223-3) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (ADJ vs GND); fixed vs adjustable LDO feedback configuration mismatch. Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (ADJ vs GND). Under a representative 5 V → 1.25 V rail at 150 mA (563 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 34.6 °C on LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB (θJA 61.6 °C/W) vs 60.8 °C on NCP1117LPST33T3G (θJA 108 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 3.1x ratio (1700 µA (p.8) vs 550 µA (p.3)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB "Pin 1 Is ADJ (NOT GND) — NEVER Drop Into Fixed 3.3 V / 5.0 V Footprints Without Feedback Resistors" (p.3) and NCP1117LPST33T3G "20 mOhm Minimum ESR Floor Still Blocks Bare Low-ESR MLCCs Despite Modern 'LP' Label" (p.2). BOM decision: Choose LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB when input rails climb above 12 V (rated to 15 V) or lower package θJA (61.6 °C/W) is needed for thermal margin; choose NCP1117LPST33T3G when load current exceeds 800 mA (up to 1000 mA) or battery sleep budget demands 550 µA Iq. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.1) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
